summary: The audit checks the laboratory or methods course, the seminar (three quarters of formal seminars, or APPPHYS 290 plus a signed list of eight talks), 6 units of technical electives from APPPHYS, CS, CME, EE, ME, BIOE, MATSCI or PHYSICS, and the four letter-graded breadth courses. Your graduate units must reach 45, at least 36 of them letter graded. You move in the three advisor-approved depth courses (nine units, one at the 300 level) and any petitioned elective.

totals.label: 36 letter-graded units
totals.why: Grading: "Of the 45 required units, 36 units must be letter graded."

o0PR6aeR.why: "Complete a minimum of 6 units to reach the 45-unit minimum for the program. Approved subjects include APPPHYS, CS, CME, EE, ME, BIOE, MATSCI, PHYSICS courses, as well as those courses that are formally approved by the Applied Physics Graduate Studies Committee through petition." Petitioned courses are moved in by hand.

qKRbYadb.why: "Complete three Engineering Depth Courses for a total of nine units. At least one must be at the 300 level and the other courses must be at the 200 level or above to provide depth in one area. To be approved by the Applied Physics academic advisor." No subject list defines an engineering course, so the student moves the approved courses in.
